accepted.feature: Terme della Basilica Cristiana (Baths of the Christian Basilica)
accepted.quote: The Baths of the Christian Basilica date to the reign of Trajan, with restorations in the early third century. Representative point: longitude 12.286571, latitude 41.753158.
accepted.note: The source dates the baths to the reign of Trajan and says they were restored in the early third century, without giving a year.
